questions.question: Which method on the Braze User object is correctly utilized to set a standard attribute on the user profile in Android?
questions.explanation: The correct Android method is Braze.getInstance().getUser().setEmail() to set standard user attributes.

questions.question: True or False: In the Android SDK, you can customize notification sounds for push messages.
questions.explanation: Android allows customization of notification sounds through the Braze SDK configuration.
